scope: Reader-facing derived tables only. M1/M5 reporting clarification on 2026-10-02; no experiment, retraining or historical artifact mutation. S82 governs target/representation meaning; unified_split_contract_v2 governs the frozen split.

comparison_rules: Compare service-time predictions only on the same evaluation target, compatible observed-service output clocks, identical frozen split and identical held-out IDs. Fidelity and representation differences must be declared; they need not be identical.

Outer-train-calibrated analytical adaptations may be compared with graph/polynomial adaptations on the same held-out service labels. Keep raw schedule/throughput/effective-cost outputs in cross-clock diagnostics.
Every pairwise statement names its common successful row count and reports each method's full-envelope coverage separately.
A coverage-asymmetric comparison describes only the common successful rows, not excluded rows or universal full-envelope superiority.

Source-stratified and equal-source MAE summaries are primary summaries of one unified OOF run; pooled observation-weighted metrics are secondary. Report QPack equal-workflow MAE alongside its ordinary source MAE.
QPack workflow-held-out allows seen structural templates: six reconstructed structures recur across 46 workflows. It does not establish unseen-structure accuracy.
Never assign zero error to unavailable, failed, timeout, nonfinite or missing predictions. Preserve all terminal outcomes in coverage.
Different representations qualify a pipeline comparison; they do not isolate an architecture effect. Source-native results on 340/4482 are separate from the unified OOF envelope.

statistical_summary_policy.source_slices: Derive from the same unified OOF predictions; do not refit source-specific models or replace outer folds.
statistical_summary_policy.source_balanced_mae: Unweighted arithmetic mean of Ma-Li, Qonductor and QPack source MAEs. Pairwise source means use exactly the same successful rows per source. Require all three sources; otherwise emit unavailable plus source counts.
statistical_summary_policy.qpack_workflow_balanced_mae: Mean of within-workflow MAEs over represented workflows, each workflow equally weighted. Report represented/assigned workflows and per-workflow coverage; missing workflows have no numeric error.
statistical_summary_policy.pooled_mae: Observation-weighted mean on the declared successful rows; secondary mixture summary, not unseen-source transfer.
statistical_summary_policy.log1p_mae: mean(abs(log1p(predicted_seconds) - log1p(target_seconds))) under the method's frozen nonnegative-output policy; no aggregation-time clipping or replacement of nonfinite values
statistical_summary_policy.r2: Compute only with nonzero target variance; arithmetic mean of source R2, if emitted, is macro R2 rather than pooled R2.
statistical_summary_policy.seed_reduction: Use the method's frozen registry; for unified neural adaptations preserve seeds 42,1234,31415 and reduce by rowwise median. Preserve individual-seed predictions/metrics. Never select the best test seed.
statistical_summary_policy.paired_point_estimate: MAE(candidate) - MAE(reference), directly on the declared original shared rows. Negative favors candidate. Bootstrap replicate mean is separately labelled.

bootstrap.mali_cluster: Frozen unified leakage group representing logical-QASM identity
bootstrap.qonductor_cluster: Frozen unified leakage group representing submitted-QASM identity
bootstrap.resampling: Sample whole groups with replacement within source; retain all paired member rows and repeated-draw multiplicity. Share each draw between candidate and reference.
bootstrap.cross_source_lineage_check: The frozen split_manifest_v2.json records zero proven cross-source edges. Verify this before source-stratified draws. A newly proven joint component requires a reviewed coupled-cluster protocol, not independent source draws or a silent split change.
bootstrap.source_balanced_interval: Recompute source metrics and their equal-source mean in each paired replicate; do not reuse a pooled CI or average interval endpoints.
bootstrap.workflow_balanced_interval: Resample whole QPack workflows and recompute equal-workflow means; retain represented/assigned counts.
bootstrap.scope: Conditional uncertainty of frozen fitted OOF predictions, not full retraining/seed uncertainty; include cluster counts and all predeclared comparisons.
bootstrap.historical_results: Preserve historical metric contracts and values. These rules describe new derived summaries, not previously computed intervals.

comparison_rules: Do not pool errors across engines, output APIs, precision modes, hardware contexts, first/warm clocks, or quality policies.
MPS timing requires the declared quality threshold; quality_failed remains in the attempted denominator.
cuTensorNet RUNTIME_EST compares only with the matching selected-plan scalar contraction; network build and path search are telemetry, not target labels.
A local engine timing row is not automatically a runtime-prediction method row.
